title: Native agent tool v1 binding
summary: Bind a stable allowlisted native AgentTool with exact declared API, permission and edit reach. The tool's historical governed dispatcher remains the executor.

replaceability.why: The adapter and layering machinery are the Host foundation. If this machinery could be replaced by a creator layer, automatic fallback to the original could not be guaranteed. The Lucs carried by open protocols have their own replacement classes.
replaceability.decided: Acrab, self-Luc spec v0.3, 2026-10-18; interface charter rule 6, 2026-10-22

reach.notes: Trusted Host machinery, not authority granted to a Luc. Package calls remain bounded by their resolved permissions, Host APIs and editable scope.

operations.name: compile
operations.notes: No deadline. Native tool must exist, surface is native-agent-tool, and schemas must match tool.parameters and object result. Mismatches raise ValueError.

operations.name: validate_authority
operations.notes: No deadline. All binding APIs must be required, no excess API/permission reach; read tools edit none and writes must be fully covered. Refuses via ValueError.

operations.name: invoke
operations.notes: No deadline at adapter; native tool keeps its own idempotency and domain refusals. Effective editable scope is rechecked, then tool.run(context, arguments). Native result validator can raise ValidationError.

invariants.text: The binding delegates to the existing tool.run, never code named by a package.

break: The operation rejects invalid input, integrity, authority or binding state as described by its operation.

conformance.notes: Existing tests listed here were inspected, not run for this documentation task. The area checker validates the contract files; it does not exercise runtime behavior.

known_deviations.text: Core's NATIVE_AGENT_TOOL_POLICIES is empty today; this compatibility adapter does not establish a live binding for any shipped tool.
